messages:
eli: quick sync: product asked for a "gracepath" spec for customers migrating into catalog when they request waivers for full benchmark runs (eg: data residency or time pressure). want a defensible, auditable path.
noor: how do waivers look? temp pin + sampled validation?
eli: proposing: a waiver token that allows lightweight validation (<=200 examples) + mandatory sampling+audit for 14 days. waiver auto-expires; conversion to normal pin requires full bench later.
zara: ops concern: sampled validation must still feed drift monitors. can we tag those samples and route to evaluation cluster? ops_bot: yes — add sample tag and run daily mini-eval job; cost small.
frank: customer asks also include quota offsets while on gracepath. proposed: bill at standard rate but provide one-time migration credit when they convert within 10 days. avoids promising SLA.
noor: acceptance criteria for gracepath entry: 1) waiver token issued and logged, 2) trimmed harness passed (sanity + latency smoke), 3) sample capture enabled, 4) customer-facing doc with guardrails.
eli: UI flows: "request waiver" button -> policy check -> grant token with TTL -> show "gracepath" badge in catalog. small UI change. zara: 2-3 pts.
frank: telemetry: track waiver_count, conversion_rate, avg_time-to-convert, post-conversion regression rate. target conversion >60% for pilot.
zara: rollout plan: pilot 5 customers, internal canary first, 7-day pilot, evaluate metrics, then scale. auto-unpin after TTL unless converted.
noor: legal: waiver template must state no SLA and limited liability. eli: cc legal in ticket.
ops_bot: created ticket infra#4567 for sample tagging + mini-eval job (ETA 5 days).
eli: owners: noor -> waiver policy doc + client-facing wording; zara -> infra sampling PR; frank -> billing credit flow; eli -> UI mock. reconvene Mon after infra PR.
noor: noted. will draft policy by Fri.
eli: thanks team. we'll add this to the roadmap as a "gracepath" beta and include migration credit pilot in the MRR playbook.
